properties.name: module_width
properties.comment: The preferred module width before text scaling; finite and positive (std::invalid_argument otherwise). A view onto the rack's layout state; a change re-lays out the modules.
hand: a view onto the rack's Impl; write_view keeps the refusal and re-lays out the modules

properties.name: module_height
properties.comment: The module height before text scaling; finite and positive (std::invalid_argument otherwise). A view onto the rack's layout state; a change re-lays out the modules.
hand: a view onto the rack's Impl; write_view keeps the refusal and re-lays out the modules

properties.name: rack_gap
properties.comment: The gap between modules before text scaling; finite and nonnegative (std::invalid_argument otherwise). A view onto the rack's layout state; a change re-lays out the modules.
hand: a view onto the rack's Impl; write_view keeps the refusal and re-lays out the modules

properties.name: scroll_offset
properties.comment: The vertical scroll position, clamped to the content; a view, since revealing a module moves it. A non-finite offset throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: a view onto the rack's Impl, which reveal moves directly; write_view clamps and re-arranges the modules

not_properties.name: modules
not_properties.reason: the model is replaced whole and validated as a set; collections stay methods

not_properties.name: action_content
not_properties.reason: structural slot with a minimum width (G10)
